name: Incorrect payroll calculations -> misstated wages and deductions
rationale: Errors in rates, tax tables or deduction parameters flow systematically into pay and related liabilities. The rule directs independent recalculation from authorised sources, agreement of rates, and reconciliation of payroll to the ledger.
